query:
SELECT 
  m.id,
  m.sponsorId,
  s.companyName as sponsorName,
  m.attendeeId,
  m.timeSlot,
  m.matchScore,
  m.isVisible
FROM meetings m
LEFT JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
ORDER BY m.sponsorId, m.timeSlot;
